summary: 健康/容量/积压基线实现 on BASE fe9c257. Implements scripts/ops/healthcheck.py against the PH-345 V1-OPS-05 read-only contract: PH-345 evidence envelope v1, append-only JSONL dedupe, exit codes 0 pass / 2 not_run / 3 fail / 4 environment error / 5 security refusal; dry_run default; execute restricted to --env rehearsal with staging/production execute blocked exit 5. Local/test redacted facts feed health checks (DB reachability/migration pending/cache/worker/disk/backup age), capacity checks (connection utilisation, largest table bytes, slow-query count, attachment bytes), backlog checks (queue depth/reminders/todos/unsettled with frozen local thresholds), and perf samples (nearest-rank P50/P95) without guessing production SLOs. Missing facts/environment return not_run exit 2; sensitive keys are recursively redacted so no password/token/credential/customer/payroll values enter evidence. Adds docs/engineering/observability.md with the frozen facts schema/thresholds/evidence/not_run discipline and updates ops-runbook V1-OPS-05 from unimplemented/blocked to local/rehearsal implemented. Real CI/deployment capacity, PG/table/slow-query/attachment/queue metrics and page P50/P95 remain not_run and are explicitly not claimed from local numbers. No production access, product code, migration, contract schema, canonical or CI-gate changes. Scoped 7 tests cover envelope, exit codes, missing environment, staging/production refusal, backlog/disk/backup/connection/migration thresholds, redaction, P50/P95 and JSONL idempotency.
